meta.title: Trucker: road freight across the Gulf
meta.description: Trucker is a planned road freight platform for shippers, carriers, vehicle owners and drivers, in English, Arabic and Urdu.

environment.development: Development build. Not a live service. All content is sample content.

hero.title: Road freight across the Gulf, one signed step at a time
hero.lead: Shipper, carrier and driver work from the same record, from pick-up to proof of delivery. In English, Arabic and Urdu.

example.title: Dubai to Riyadh
example.label: Illustration
example.note: The shipper, the carrier and operations read this same list. Each step shows who signed it and when.

items.title: Post the load
items.text: Describe the goods, the sites and the time windows once.

items.title: Compare offers and book
items.text: Verified carriers quote. You accept one, with the price and terms fixed.

items.title: Follow each signed step
items.text: The driver signs every milestone, even without signal.

items.title: Confirm proof of delivery
items.text: Photos and the receiver's signature close the job.

items.title: Shippers
items.text: Describe a load once, compare offers on the same terms and follow every step to delivery.

items.title: Carriers
items.text: See loads that fit your fleet and the routes you are permitted to run. Assign truck, trailer and driver.

items.title: Drivers and vehicle owners
items.text: One clear next step at every stop. Steps are saved on the phone when there is no signal.

languages.title: The same sign in three languages
languages.lead: Every screen is designed in English, Arabic and Urdu. Arabic and Urdu read right to left; numbers, plates and references stay left to right.

footer.note: Draft copy. The service described is planned, not live. Launch countries and routes are not decided.

verify.lead: Trucker staff review an organisation before it can trade. You submit its details with the evidence entries asked for, and see the outcome here.
verify.demoNotice: Demonstration only. The requirements shown are fictional test data, not any country's real requirements. What you type are your own declarations: no document is uploaded or checked. A verification given on them does not allow publication in production.

fleet.closed: Fleet records are not available here: no document or category list exists.
fleet.registrationHint: Letters and digits. Spaces and dashes are ignored.

book.title: Bookings
book.statusNote: Not confirmed. A booking is confirmed only when the carrier has assigned and reserved every resource it needs. Nothing is assigned yet.
book.provisional: The fee, payment period, assignment deadline and reservation times are development values. They are not approved for real use.
book.taxNote: No tax is calculated or shown here. How tax applies is not decided.
book.payment: The shipper pays the carrier by bank transfer within {n} days of accepting the proof of delivery. Trucker does not hold the transport money.
book.termsNote: Demonstration terms for development only. They are not approved terms and bind nobody.
book.assignmentDue: The carrier assigns its resources by
book.plannedNote: A plan only: nothing is reserved yet.
book.acceptNote: Accepting is final. It creates one booking with these figures and ends the other quotations.

cannotAccept.not_open: This quotation is no longer open.
cannotAccept.reconfirmation_needed: Waiting for the carrier to confirm it for the changed shipment.
cannotAccept.carrier_not_eligible: The carrier may not carry this shipment now.
cannotAccept.assignment_deadline_passed: The pick-up is too soon for the carrier to assign its resources in time, so this cannot be accepted.

book.unavailable: The booking could not be loaded. Try again.
book.cancelledNote: This booking has ended. The figures below are the original booking snapshot, not a cancellation charge.

asg.title: Booking
asg.confirmedNote: Confirmed: the carrier has assigned and reserved every resource this booking needs. Confirmed does not mean dispatched.
asg.plannedReserved: The carrier's resources are reserved for this time.
asg.overdue: The carrier has not assigned its resources by the deadline. Nothing happens automatically.
asg.waitRecorded: The shipper decided to wait for the carrier.
asg.waitNote: This records your decision to wait. It cancels nothing and charges nothing. Cancelling a booking is not available yet.
asg.dispatchReady: Nothing blocks dispatch now. Dispatch itself is not available yet.

blockers.needs_reassignment: A resource no longer meets a requirement. The carrier must reassign it. The booking is not cancelled.
blockers.resource_occupied: A resource is still on another trip.
blockers.resource_overrunning: A resource is still on another trip past its planned end. This booking is at risk.
blockers.acknowledgement_missing: The driver has not acknowledged the assignment.

asg.resourcesHidden: The vehicles and the driver are shown once the booking is confirmed.
asg.notAcknowledged: The driver has not acknowledged this assignment.
asg.assignLead: Choose the whole set. Each resource is reserved for the planned time. The booking is confirmed when the set is complete.
asg.assignLeadConfirmed: This booking is confirmed. A resource can be replaced, not taken away. A vehicle of another category takes effect only when the shipper accepts it. The price does not change.
asg.trailerHint: Only for a truck that pulls a trailer.
asg.cannotAssign: The carrier cannot assign resources now.

reasons.reserved: reserved for another booking at this time
reasons.trailer_not_needed: this truck does not pull a trailer

asg.siteNote: Shown to the carrier from confirmation. No site contact is held.
asg.substitutionShipper: The carrier proposes different vehicles. The price does not change. The current vehicles stay unless you accept.
asg.substitutionCarrier: Waiting for the shipper's decision. The current set stays until then.
